_note: Prerendered library. The bridge sends one of these ids; the glasses app holds the full content and scenes. 'unknown' = not in the library.

objects.label: Guitar string
objects.detect_hint: a guitar, ukulele or any plucked string instrument, or a close-up of strings and frets
objects.concept: Standing waves: a shorter string vibrates faster, so the note is higher

objects.label: Thrown ball
objects.detect_hint: any ball (tennis, football, basketball, crumpled paper ball) held in a hand or about to be thrown
objects.concept: Projectile motion: gravity bends the path into a parabola; 45 degrees goes furthest without air drag

objects.label: Bike gears
objects.detect_hint: a bicycle, its chain, chainring, cassette or rear gears
objects.concept: Gear ratio: a big front and small back gear trades pedalling force for speed

objects.label: Boiling kettle
objects.detect_hint: a kettle, pot of water, or a cup or mug of hot drink
objects.concept: Convection: hot water rises, cool water sinks, bubbles are water turning to vapour

objects.label: Swinging keys
objects.detect_hint: keys on a lanyard or string, a necklace, a yo-yo, anything hanging that can swing
objects.concept: Pendulum: the swing time depends on the length, not the weight
